info.description: Multi-tenant e-commerce API — manage products, orders, customers, payments, and webhooks.

parameters.description: Optional filter by order status (pending, confirmed, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled).

400.description: Invalid order data or insufficient stock.

Initiates a payment for an order via Razorpay.
Returns Razorpay order details for frontend integration.

requestBody.description: Payment creation request with order ID and optional idempotency key.

400.description: Invalid request or order validation failed.

get.summary:
Verifies the current status of a payment.
Used to check if payment has been completed by the customer.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The payment ID to verify status for.

post.summary:
Requests a refund for a completed payment.
Can process full or partial refunds.

requestBody.description: Refund request with reason and optional amount.

400.description: Invalid refund request or cannot refund payment.

post.summary:
Saves payment gateway credentials for the current tenant.
Encrypts and securely stores Razorpay API keys and webhook secret.

requestBody.description: The payment configuration request containing Razorpay credentials.

400.description: Invalid request or missing required fields.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

409.description: Configuration already exists for this tenant.

500.description: An error occurred while saving configuration.

get.summary:
Retrieves the payment configuration for the current tenant.
Secrets are masked in the response for security.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

404.description: Payment configuration not found for this tenant.

500.description: An error occurred while retrieving configuration.

delete.summary:
Deletes the payment configuration for the current tenant.
This action disables payment processing until new configuration is provided.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

404.description: Payment configuration not found for this tenant.

500.description: An error occurred while deleting configuration.

post.summary:
Validates payment gateway credentials by attempting to connect to Razorpay API.
This endpoint helps ensure configuration is correct before enabling payment processing.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

404.description: Payment configuration not found for this tenant.

get.summary:
Checks if payment configuration exists and is active for the current tenant.
This endpoint is useful for frontend to determine if payment processing is available.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

500.description: An error occurred while checking status.

get.summary: Gets the current subscription details for the tenant.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

get.summary: Gets a list of all available subscription plans with feature comparison.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

post.summary:
Upgrades the subscription to a higher plan.
If a pro-rata charge is required, a payment is triggered automatically.

requestBody.description: The upgrade plan request containing the new plan ID.

400.description: Invalid plan ID or cannot upgrade to same/lower tier.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

404.description: Subscription or target plan not found.

409.description: Subscription is already pending cancellation or in an invalid state.

post.summary:
Downgrades the subscription to a lower plan.
A credit is applied to the next billing cycle for the price difference.

requestBody.description: The downgrade plan request containing the new plan ID.

400.description: Invalid plan ID or cannot downgrade to same/higher tier.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

404.description: Subscription or target plan not found.

409.description: Subscription is already pending cancellation or in an invalid state.

post.summary:
Requests subscription cancellation with a 30-day grace period.
After the grace period, the subscription will be fully deactivated.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

409.description: Subscription is already pending cancellation or in an invalid state.

post.summary:
Reactivates a cancelled subscription during the 30-day grace period.
After the grace period expires, the subscription cannot be reactivated.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

404.description: Subscription not found or is not pending cancellation.

409.description: Grace period has expired; subscription cannot be reactivated.

tags.name: AdminConfig
tags.description:
API controller for platform-wide configuration management endpoints.
Accessible only to SuperUser role.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description:
Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, token refresh, and OAuth authentication.
These endpoints are publicly accessible without authorization.

tags.name: Config
tags.description:
API controller for tenant-specific configuration management endpoints.
Accessible to TenantAdmin role.

tags.name: Health
tags.description:
Health check endpoint controller.
Provides liveness and readiness checks with Redis keep-alive.

tags.name: PaymentConfiguration
tags.description:
Controller for managing tenant payment configurations.
Provides endpoints to configure, retrieve, validate, and delete payment gateway credentials.

tags.name: Payment
tags.description:
Controller for managing payments and payment verification.
Handles payment creation, status verification, and refund requests.

tags.name: RazorpayWebhookReceiver
tags.description:
Webhook receiver controller for Razorpay payment and subscription events.
These endpoints are public and do not require authentication.

tags.name: StorefrontComponent
tags.description: Controller for managing storefront components (TenantAdmin+ authorization required).

tags.name: Storefront
tags.description: Controller for managing storefronts (TenantAdmin+ authorization required).

tags.name: Subscription
tags.description: Controller for managing subscription plans and lifecycle.

tags.name: Theme
tags.description:
Controller for retrieving themes (public - no tenant authorization required).
Themes are platform-wide resources available to all tenants.

tags.name: Webhook
tags.description:
API controller for webhook management endpoints.
Accessible only to TenantAdmin role.
